title: Rayman 2 controller settings
author: idontwannaforgetmyusernameorpassword
body: The default settings don't have --button-to-touch settings for Rayman 2. Anyone got some?

comments.author: ciciplusplus
comments.body: This is not as straightforward as it may seems, as we don't have support for simulating "pull-to-move" thumbsticks required for Rayman 2.
